title: Provider Abstraction Layer
summary: This module defines the abstract `Provider` class, serving as a base for integrating various AI model APIs. It manages client authentication, HTTP client lifecycle, and provides a standardized interface for accessing different model providers.

nodes.label: Provider Abstract Base Class
nodes.title: Provider (ABC)
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface and lifecycle management for all AI model providers, ensuring consistent integration and resource handling.

nodes.label: Specific API Client
nodes.title: InterfaceClient (Generic)
nodes.description: A generic type representing the concrete API client (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) that a specific provider implementation will wrap and utilize.

nodes.label: Asynchronous HTTP Client
nodes.title: httpx.AsyncClient
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous network requests for interacting with external AI model APIs, handling connection pooling and ensuring proper client closure.

nodes.label: Model Configuration Profile
nodes.title: ModelProfile
nodes.description: Provides metadata and specific configurations for a given AI model, such as supported features, default parameters, or provider-specific settings.

nodes.label: Concurrency Management Lock
nodes.title: anyio.Lock
nodes.description: Ensures thread-safe operations during the asynchronous entry and exit of the provider's context, preventing race conditions and managing resource access.

groups.label: Core Abstraction
groups.title: Core Provider Abstraction
groups.description: The central abstract class defining the contract for all AI model providers.

groups.label: Internal Dependencies
groups.title: Provider Internal Dependencies
groups.description: Components that the abstract Provider class relies on for its functionality, including client management and concurrency.

groups.label: Configuration & Metadata
groups.title: Model Configuration & Metadata
groups.description: Mechanisms for retrieving and managing specific model profiles and settings.
